flags.title: Features
flags.description: Turn AI features on or off for this department. Off by default until you enable them.
flags.headOnly: Only a department head can change these.

empty.title: No AI calls yet
empty.body: Usage will appear here once someone in this department tries an AI feature.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.description: Try an AI feature: fill in the fields, preview the result, then copy it or use it in the matching screen.

disabled.title: This feature is off
disabled.body: Ask a department head to turn it on in the Overview tab.

budgetExceeded.title: This month's AI budget is used up
budgetExceeded.body: Ask a department head to raise the monthly budget in the Overview tab.

errors.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again
errors.forbidden: This feature is off or the budget is used up
errors.runFailed: The AI could not produce an answer this time

quickAddParse.label: Quick-add parsing
quickAddParse.description: Turn a free-typed sentence into a card title, assignee, due date and priority, in any of the four locales.

subtaskBreakdown.label: Break into subtasks
subtaskBreakdown.description: Split one card into a checklist of concrete, actionable subtasks.

planSprint.label: Plan my period
planSprint.description: Suggest an order for your open personal to-dos and what to focus on first.

deadlineRisk.label: Deadline risk
deadlineRisk.description: Explain whether a card is at risk of missing its deadline, and what to do about it.

weeklySummary.label: Weekly summary
weeklySummary.description: Draft a short digest for one person or one department, from done/overdue/new cards.

draftEvent.label: Draft an event
draftEvent.description: Turn a one-line idea into a description, checklist, poll options and a carpool plan.

summarizeThread.label: Summarise a thread
summarizeThread.description: Summarise a long card comment thread, citing the comments it is based on.

nlAnalytics.label: Ask analytics
nlAnalytics.description: Turn a plain-language question into a filter and a chart type.

translate.label: Translate
translate.description: Translate text into any of the four locales.

whatDidIMiss.label: What did I miss
whatDidIMiss.description: Catch up on new cards, comments and events since you were last here.
